constraints.text: Principle IV: verification executes in the environment the code runs in; the gate testing the lock while cerebro runs freshly resolved versions breaks it.
uv tool install --reinstall bypasses daemon/uv.lock; the prior fix pinned only git sources with rev=, leaving PyPI dependencies to float on every deploy.
The 2026-10-07 cerebro deploy installed pydantic 2.13.5, trafilatura 2.3.1 and lxml 6.1.3 while daemon/uv.lock locks pydantic 2.11.7, trafilatura 2.0.0 and lxml 5.4.0.
Measured: uv sync --python 3.14 on the current lock fails building pydantic-core 2.33.2 ('the configured Python interpreter version (3.14) is newer than PyO3's maximum supported version (3.13)').

Measured in a scratch worktree: after `uv lock --upgrade` in both units with .python-version at 3.14, the daemon suite passes on 3.14.6 (980 passed, 7 skipped), the CLI suite passes (126), mypy and ruff are clean in both, and the refreshed daemon lock differs from cerebro's installed set only by fastapi 0.142.3 vs 0.142.2 and three platform-only packages.
Neither verify.sh nor .github/workflows/ci.yml names a Python version; both run through `uv run`, so .python-version alone decides CI's interpreter.
`uv tool install` accepts `-c/--constraints <requirements file>`, and `uv export --locked --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-hashes` writes the lock as one.
Keeping requires-python at >=3.13 leaves the lock resolvable for 3.13 too, so a host still on 3.13 keeps working until it reinstalls.
